part.text:
Compilation succeeded. The fixes addressed all reported errors:
- `TokenType` members renamed to uppercase (`STRING`, `NUMERIC`, `TEMPORAL`, `STRUCTURED`, `BINARY`, `NULL`) each with a `value: String` carrying the canonical name.
- Added `TokenContainer[T]` (with `getAll` / `mapTokens`).
- Added `tokenizeNull` to the top-level `api` object.
- Added `TokenRegistry[T]` (with `register`, `addHandler`, `process`).
- Added `TokenFunctor[T]` (with `map`, `flatMap`, `getOrElse`).
- Fixed `Option` access in `TokenRegistry.process`.
